items.title: Royal Caribbean to Acquire 50% Stake in Sandals and Beaches Resorts for About $3 Billion
items.summary: Royal Caribbean Group (NYSE:RCL) has agreed to acquire a 50% stake in Sandals and Beaches Resorts for approximately $3 billion, expanding the cruise operator’s business into the all-inclusive resort market. The companies said Wednesday that the investment will create a joint venture combining the Caribbean resort portfolio of Sandals and Beaches with Royal Caribbean’s cruise, private destination and vacation operations.
